rules.title: Application Fee Cap
rules.requirement: Landlords and their agents cannot charge a residential rental application or screening fee exceeding $50. The fee limit is subject to annual adjustments based on the Consumer Price Index.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental properties, excluding one-family or two-family dwellings offered for rent and real estate licensees acting as agents rather than landlords.

rules.exemptions: One-family or two-family dwellings offered for rent; a licensee of the New Jersey Real Estate Commission unless the licensee is the landlord.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
